mapper.sql: o.id, o.customer_id, o.status, o.amount, o.memo, o.ordered_at
mapper.select:
SELECT , o.amount::text AS amount_text, c.name AS customer_name, c.profile->>'grade' AS grade FROM orders o /* 이전에는 orders_backup 도 읽었다 */ JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
AND c.name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND o.status IN
#{st}::order_status
AND o.ordered_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert:
SELECT nextval('orders_id_seq')
INSERT INTO orders (id, customer_id, status, amount, memo) VALUES (#{id}, #{customerId}, 'NEW', #{amount}, #{memo})

INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, qty, unit_price) VALUES
(#{orderId}, #{it.productId}, #{it.qty}, #{it.unitPrice})
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: UPDATE ONLY orders o SET status = #{status}::order_status, memo = #{memo} FROM customers c WHERE c.id = o.customer_id AND c.email = #{email} RETURNING o.id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM payments p USING orders o WHERE o.id = p.order_id AND o.status = 'CANCELLED' AND o.ordered_at < #{before}
mapper.select: WITH paid AS ( UPDATE orders o SET status = 'PAID' FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id = o.id AND o.status = 'NEW' AND p.paid_at IS NOT NULL RETURNING o.id, o.customer_id ), touched AS ( UPDATE customers c SET profile = jsonb_set(coalesce(c.profile, '{}'::jsonb), '{last_paid}', to_jsonb(now())) FROM paid WHERE c.id = paid.customer_id RETURNING c.id ) SELECT count(*) AS orders_paid, (SELECT count(*) FROM touched) AS customers_touched FROM paid

SELECT p.id, p.sku, p.attrs->>'color' AS color, coalesce(sum(i.qty) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'PAID'), 0) AS paid_qty, count(DISTINCT o.id) FILTER (WHERE o.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'CANCELLED') AS order_cnt FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id GROUP BY p.id, p.sku, p.attrs
SELECT t.event_type, t.created_at, t.status FROM order_timeline(#{orderId}) AS t
